title: A group's pack ranker, named as extension point ranker, adds one ranked list that kbfacts.rrf fuses, and with none set every pack is byte for byte as before
goal: kbfacts.pack calls the ranker extensions.ranker names as rank(question, candidates) with the candidate articles' qualified paths; kbfacts.rrf fuses the list it returns as one more expert so an article it puts first ranks no lower than without it; a path it returns that is no candidate is dropped; an exception or an answer that is no list leaves the pack as without a ranker and prints one stderr line naming the point; with no ranker set rag.py eval's held-out results are unchanged

gates.question: Which articles does the ranker see and reorder, and for which packs?
options: The pool of candidate articles before the max_articles cut, kb roots only (not --root _self, not an item brief)
Only the max_articles printed articles, for every pack
gates.recommendation: The pool of candidate articles before the max_articles cut, kb roots only (not --root _self, not an item brief)
gates.reason: the ranker can lift an article the BM25 order left below the cut, and the rule docs and item briefs keep their tested passages
gates.answer: The pool of candidate articles before the max_articles cut, kb roots only (not --root _self, not an item brief)

gates.question: A ranker that is set but cannot be loaded (bad module, version outside KBEXT_REQUIRES, bad settings): what does the pack do?
options: Print one kbext stderr line naming the point and rank without it, retried at the next pack
gates.recommendation: Print one kbext stderr line naming the point and rank without it, retried at the next pack
gates.reason: the goal says a failing ranker leaves the pack as without one, and a lookup never fails for a group's extender
gates.answer: Print one kbext stderr line naming the point and rank without it, retried at the next pack

notes: Check 2 (the held-out eval) passes before the work: with no ranker set the pack must rank as it does now.
